propositions: Plan text must be moved from Pass-2 user message into both verifier system prompts by replacing {{plan}} with {{shared_prefix}} to enable within-pass chunk reuse and cross-run prefix caching within Anthropic's ephemeral 5-minute TTL

A single-source structural invariant in prompts.py (shared_plan_prefix function) must enforce byte-identity of the plan-bearing prefix across Pass-1 finder and both verifier system prompts to position for provider-side prefix reuse and prevent drift

Pass-1 entry points (finder, container, ISF) must include an exhaustiveness directive bullet ('enumerate EVERY independent defect') in the shared reviewing stance preamble to cover incremental-depth BLOCK loops
The Pass-1 warm gate condition must measure tokens of shared_plan_prefix(plan) rather than plan alone to accurately gate on the actual cached-prefix size
Verifier templates must drop the volatile marker and {{plan}} tail block, making the entire rendered template the stable system prompt; finding listings remain user-turn via base_instructions
plan_review_verify_inputs must emit shared_prefix output (replacing plan output) and both plan-review.yaml verify steps must wire that output into template variables
